blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Dasha and Anya made their own visual novel.
exercises.ru: Даша с Аней сделали ___ визуальную новеллу.
exercises.why: «The possessive "свой" indicates that the object belongs to the performer of the action … When the performer of the action is in the 3rd person … the possessives "его, её, их" are used if the object does not belong to the performer of the action. If the object belongs to the performer of the action, the possessive "свой" must be used.» — DLI, Lesson 49. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
